description: Source code for the 'blackfriday' Markdown processor, including parsing, extensions, rendering interface, and link reference handling.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Bitwise flags representing enabled Markdown extensions.

classes.name: ListType
classes.description: Flags for list and list item types.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Interface for rendering parsed Markdown nodes.

classes.name: Markdown
classes.description: Main processor struct holding extensions, state, and rendering info.

classes.name: Reference
classes.description: Structure representing link or footnote references.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructs a new Markdown processor with optional configurations.

methods.name: getRef
methods.description: Retrieves a reference by ID, considering override functions.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Closes a block node and updates the current tip.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a new child node of a specific type at a given offset.

methods.name: addExistingChild
methods.description: Adds an existing node as a child, finalizing parent nodes as needed.

methods.name: closeUnmatchedBlocks
methods.description: Finalizes any open blocks to match the last container.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses input Markdown into a syntax tree.

methods.name: parseRefsToAST
methods.description: Processes footnote references and appends them to the AST.
